newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Amper outperforms after results.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Amper outperforms after results.

text.p: Shares in Spanish telephone equipment firm Amper outperformed stock indices on Thursday after the company announced a big jump in results for the first five months of this year.
At 0950 GMT the shares were up 65 pesetas, 1.56 percent, to 4,225 pesetas, while the Ibex-35 gained 0.22 percent to 6,928.17.
"People are optimistic after these results," a dealer in Madrid said.

Earlier today Amper said its net profit rose 57 percent in the five months to May to 2.39 billion pesetas. But it also said that 1997 profits will be in line with 1996, after the latter year saw extraordinary gains from assets sales.
"Given that the market is being driven domestically, all news seems to be good news," a second dealer in Madrid said.

Traders added that there was little scope for Amper shares to make further gains, and although the current price was suggesting a "hold" recommendation, any further advance could mark the right time to sell.
